Get the banquet it is an amazing taste fest.
Aug 2018 • Couples
We tried 3 banquets plus one side dish (a must have of crispy pork fried rice) for 4 people, to much food, but soooooo goooood. 
Next time we had 3 banquets plus two sides and still to much food, but still amazing flavors. The only complaint was they want to bring everything out to quick, so the second time we asked them to slow down the service and it made it so much better. Enjoy the chili sauce it’s not hot but has great flavor.

Good food
Aug 2018 • Couples
It's located in the Oriental suite hotel near Hoan Kiem lake. The restaurant decor is beautifully presented with comfy chairs or sofa. Half of the restaurant floor are covered with thick glass. You can see a koi fish swimming underneath your feet. Their hospitality was also something I found very genuine and sincere. We didn't order from their a-la carte menu, they still let us had our dinner ordering from the delivery menu. Stir fried pho noodles is our favorite dish. It's worth a visit for the Hanoi trip.

Delicious Food Well Presented
Nov 2017 • Couples
Viet Deli is located in the Oriental Suites Hotel where we were staying. We enjoyed the breakfast options (Vietnamese and Western), 10 course lunch, and dinner. The food is very tasty, ample portions, well presented by attentive but not obtrusive wait staff. The restaurant is nicely decorated. It is the best food we have had in Vietnam so far and we will be returning in a few weeks for our final days before returning home. Prices were very reasonable for the quality of food.
